1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'Ye mighty kings who dwell on the earth, ye shall have to behold Mine Elect One, how he sits on the throne of glory and judges Azazel, and all his associates, and all his hosts in the name of the Lord of Spirits' — eschatological judgment of Azazel. Tewahedo demonology reads this verse with 10:13 (Azazel's prior binding) as a two-stage drama: temporal binding (Watchers) plus final eschatological reckoning (Parables) — establishing a pattern that Rev 20:1-10 follows.
